_comment: S3 交換尻 behavioral fixture. Each counterparty bank exercises the sign convention (D-0902: net = 受取/被仕向 02 minus 支払/仕向 01) and/or the AND-join completion guard (D-0904). amounts are whole yen. START reverses the sign AND ignores the completion flags (settles everything 'S'); GOLDEN applies 受取-支払 and HOLDS ('H') any bank whose 仕向(OUT) or 被仕向(IN) net is incomplete. The AND-join is tested on BOTH arms: 0002 has 仕向(OUT) incomplete (out_flag N), 0005 has 被仕向(IN) incomplete (in_flag N) — a hold-on-OUT-only solution settles 0005 and fails. Sign is tested positive (0001) and negative (0004).
